ننملس (form VII)
# نَنْمَلِسُ (nanmalisu) /nan.ma.li.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْمَلَسَ (inmalasa)
# نَنْمَلِسَ (nanmalisa) /nan.ma.li.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْمَلَسَ (inmalasa)
# نَنْمَلِسْ (nanmalis) /nan.ma.lis/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْمَلَسَ (inmalasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
